_comment: Package versions your organisation does not allow, with the reason. Used by the built-in 'dependencies' check (sdd/governance/checks.json) at commit and before any testing.
These four are real, publicly documented supply-chain incidents, kept as examples. Replace or extend them with your organisation's own list, or switch on a CVE scanner as well.
Governance file: change it in a chore(SDD) commit that code owners review.
